name: r4i_FxShotUpdate
notes: stack args (o a); calls 0x00190B40 with EAX=o and 0x00190A00 with EDI=o; float constants 3.0 3.3 and 5.0 loaded from .rdata by the original and stored as immediates by modern cl; the original stores the glow size a second time when kind is 0x19 (same value; dropped) and leaves mask/radius/spin uninitialised for other kinds (mask set to 1 here)

name: r4i_FxLobInit
notes: stack args (o a); 0x001C7EE1 is rand and 0x00101340 fills the target point; 1.0f/fps built with fld1 by modern cl; speed constants 34.0 and 36.0 loaded from .rdata by the original and stored as immediates by modern cl

name: r4i_FxFallMove
notes: stack args (o a); float constants 1.0 1.186824 and 1.570796 stored by modern cl as immediates where the original stores them from a register loaded from .rdata (the compares still load them from .rdata on both sides); modern cl does part of the float math on the x87 stack (precision behaviour-test priority)

name: r4i_FxHomeUpdate
notes: stack args (o a); calls 0x0018F950 with EDI=work and 0x0018F8D0 with EAX=o; 0x00100110 returns the manager; the side test is written !(d >= 0) / !(0 >= d) to keep the original jb (unordered counts as true)

name: r4i_FxChainUpdate
notes: stack args (o a); link pointer bias: the original walks link+0x34 (fields at -4 +0xC +0x3C +0x40 +0x48 +0xB4) and modern cl walks link+0x30 (fields at +4 +0x10 +0x40 +0x44 +0x4C +0xB8); both resolve to +0x30 +0x34 +0x40 +0x70 +0x74 +0x7C +0xE8 (checked by hand); float constant 1.0 stored as an immediate by modern cl; non-kind-1 set hangs (assert loop); the XZ pull keeps the original order (speed below drag then max(drag speed-pull))

name: r4i_FxSlotLand
notes: stack args (o a); calls 0x00192630 with EAX=slot index and the scale on the stack; 0x0001D0F0 called with (joint node 13) where the original pushes 13 before calling 0x000F3F80 (right-to-left argument evaluation); 1.0 - x built with fld1 by modern cl; refusal branch written with a goto so the call order matches the original layout

name: r4i_ChainFall
notes: stack arg (r); link pointer bias: the original walks link+0xE8 (fields at -0xB8 -0xB4 -0xA8 -0x78 -0x74 -0x6C) and modern cl walks the link base (+0x30 +0x34 +0x40 +0x70 +0x74 +0x7C; same fields checked by hand); float constant 1.0 stored as an immediate by modern cl; 13-link loop counted down to zero like the original

name: r4i_FxFollow
notes: stack args (o a); float constant 1.7 stored as an immediate by modern cl in the clamp (the original stores it from a register loaded from .rdata); the distance test is written !(spd >= len) to keep the original jb (unordered counts as true); 0x001A3EC0 is called with (dx dz)

name: r4i_FxAimInit
notes: stack args (o a); calls 0x00198DA0 with ESI=point and EDI=o; 0x001C7EE1 is rand; 1.0f/frames built with fld1 by modern cl; the yaw spread multiply by 2.0 (mulss from .rdata in the original) is emitted as x + x by modern cl (exact); the motion X/Y are frameSeconds * 0.0 as in the original

name: r4i_SoundInit
notes: no inputs; XDK callees stdcall and 0x001AD150 fastcall (ECX=slot); the 11-record loop at 0x0040C880 (stride 0x3C fields +0 and +8) walks record+8 in the original (0x0040C888..0x0040CB1C with a -8 field) and the record base in modern cl (0x0040C880..0x0040CB14): same table; the 16-bit query fields kind=3 and w02=1 are stored separately by the original and merged by modern cl into one 32-bit store of 0x10003 (counted as an address by the checker); the record-loop end is compared as a signed address (intptr_t) like the original

name: r4i_FxBoltUpdate
notes: stack args (o a); calls 0x001954C0 with EAX=work and 0 on the stack (the original selects 0 when part 2/13 or 3/5 exists and otherwise an uninitialised slot; that path is unreachable because the function hangs without both parts); float constant 1.0 stored as an immediate by modern cl; the destroy calls share one tail (goto) so modern cl keeps the original call order

name: r4i_SegHitCyl
notes: stack args (c seg out); 0x001A3F50 is the float square root; the radius is read before the null test of seg like the original; b = (...) * 2.0 is a mulss from .rdata in the original and x + x in modern cl (exact); the height tests are written !(0 >= y) / !(y >= -h) to keep the original jb (unordered counts as a miss); modern cl does the float math on the x87 stack (precision behaviour-test priority)

name: r4i_FxSlotThrow
notes: stack args (o a); calls 0x00192630 with EAX=slot index and 1.0 on the stack; 0x001C7EE1 is rand; float constants 1.0 (scale store) and -1.0 (forward vector) loaded from .rdata by the original and stored as immediates by modern cl; the two adjacent 16-bit counters +0x60 and +0x62 cleared with two word stores by the original and one 32-bit store at +0x60 by modern cl
